statement: Ms Alice Doe is the owner of the dwelling.
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The landlord expressly states that the dwelling meets all the conditions and requirements necessary to be used as the tenant party's permanent residence.
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The lease is agreed for the use of the dwelling by the tenant party as permanent residence.
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The agreement is made in accordance with Law 29/1994 on Urban Leases (as amended) and with what is agreed; the Civil Code applies on a supplementary basis.
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The object of the lease is the dwelling together with the furniture and household goods of the inventory signed by both parties, which forms an integral part of the agreement (a sofa, three beds with mattresses, a desk and four chairs).
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The tenant party may use the leased dwelling and furniture as a dwelling (implied by the lease).
action: use the dwelling and the furniture as a permanent residence
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The property shall be used solely as a dwelling, and no offices for the exercise of liberal or other professions may be established in it.
action: use the property for anything other than a dwelling (e.g. professional offices)
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The tenant party shall pay a rent of 11,400 euros per year, that is, 950 euros per month, within the first six days of each month, into the landlord's account.
action: pay the monthly rent into the landlord's account
deadline: within the first six days of each month
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: Once the payment period has elapsed without payment, the landlord may file a claim for termination of the agreement for non-payment, without any notice or demand.
action: file a claim for termination for non-payment, without notice or demand
activated_when (any of): The first six days of the month have passed without the tenant paying the rent. | The tenant is in breach because of a delay in paying the rent (clause 10).

statement: During the first three years, if the agreement is extended, the rent shall be updated annually in accordance with the legal reference index (IRAV) and on the terms of article 18 LAU.
action: update the rent by the IRAV index (art. 18 LAU)
activated_when (any of): A year of the agreement is completed, the agreement has been extended and three years have not yet passed.

statement: After the first three years, if the agreement is extended, both its term and the rent shall be updated by agreement between the parties.
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The term of the agreement is one year, from 1 July 2026 to 1 July 2027.
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: When the expiry date of the agreement or of an extension arrives, the agreement ends (unless it is extended).
activated_when (any of): The expiry date of the agreement or of one of its extensions arrives.

statement: On expiry, the agreement shall be compulsorily extended for annual periods until the lease reaches a minimum duration of five years.
activated_when (any of): On the expiry date, the lease has not reached a duration of five years.

statement: There is no extension if the tenant notifies the landlord of her wish not to renew, at least thirty days before the termination date of the agreement or of any of its extensions.
activated_when (any of): The tenant has notified her wish not to renew less than thirty days before expiry. | The tenant has notified the landlord of her wish not to renew, at least thirty days before expiry.

statement: Failure to observe the thirty-day notice period is penalised by the non-return of one month of the deposit.
activated_when (any of): The tenant has notified her wish not to renew less than thirty days before expiry.

statement: The minimum legal period of performance of the lease is set at six months.
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: After six months, the tenant may withdraw from the agreement; once she withdraws, the agreement ends.
activated_when (any of): After at least six months, the tenant gives notice that she withdraws from the agreement.

statement: Withdrawal by the tenant before one year has elapsed shall give rise to compensation equivalent to the proportional part of one month's rent in relation to the months remaining to complete one year.
action: pay the proportional part of one month's rent for the months remaining to complete one year
activated_when (any of): The withdrawal takes place before one year of the agreement has elapsed.

statement: In the event that the agreement is not extended, the tenant shall hand over the keys, and with them possession of the flat, to the landlord, vacated of persons.
action: hand over the keys and possession of the flat, vacated of persons
activated_when (any of): The agreement has ended.

statement: The tenant may, thirty days before the end date of each extension, give notice of termination of the agreement, reliably and in writing.
activated_when (any of): The tenant has given reliable written notice of termination thirty days before the end of an extension.

statement: The landlord may, thirty days before the end date of each extension, give notice of termination of the agreement, reliably and in writing.
activated_when (any of): The landlord has given reliable written notice of termination thirty days before the end of an extension.

statement: The dwelling is made available to the tenant on 1 July 2026 in a good state of repair, with the water and electricity installations working.
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The landlord is exempt from all liability for lack of the water and electricity supplies.
activated_when (any of): The water or electricity supply fails.

statement: The tenant party undertakes to make proper use of the household appliances.
action: make proper use of the household appliances
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: Should the household appliances break down through use, the tenant party shall repair them or replace them with others of the same characteristics.
action: repair or replace an appliance broken through use with one of the same characteristics
activated_when (any of): A household appliance has broken down through use.

statement: The tenant party may sublet the smallest room (implied by 'if the smallest room is sublet').
action: sublet the smallest room
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: If the smallest room is sublet, the tenant party shall keep the landlord informed, disclosing in writing the person who is going to live in the dwelling, with their identification details, latest payslip and employment contract.
action: disclose the subtenant in writing (identification, latest payslip and employment contract)
activated_when (any of): The tenant sublets the smallest room.

statement: Keeping flammable materials, or materials harmful or dangerous to persons or to the leased flat, is prohibited.
action: keep flammable, harmful or dangerous materials
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: Installing signs and advertisements without the landlord's authorisation is prohibited.
action: install signs or advertisements
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: With the landlord's authorisation, installing signs and advertisements is not prohibited.
activated_when (any of): The landlord has authorised a sign or advertisement.

statement: Keeping domestic animals must be notified in writing to the landlord.
action: notify the keeping of a domestic animal in writing
activated_when (any of): The tenant keeps a domestic animal in the dwelling.

statement: The tenant party is liable for any damage arising from the animal's use of the dwelling.
action: bear the damage caused by the animal
activated_when (any of): The domestic animal has caused damage to the dwelling.

statement: Carrying out works is prohibited unless they are authorised in writing by the landlord.
action: carry out works in the dwelling
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: With the landlord's written authorisation, carrying out works is not prohibited.
activated_when (any of): The landlord has authorised works in writing.

statement: Alterations and improvements made with prior authorisation revert to the landlord at the end of the agreement, without any compensation being claimable from her.
activated_when (any of): The agreement has ended and the tenant had made authorised alterations or improvements.

statement: Minor repairs (breakdowns, breakages or damage) that are shown to be due to improper use of the installations shall be borne by the tenant party.
action: bear the minor repairs due to improper use
activated_when (any of): A minor breakdown, breakage or damage is shown to be due to improper use of the installations.

statement: The tenant party, having received the dwelling in habitable condition, undertakes to return it in the same condition on the day the agreement expires.
action: return the dwelling in the same habitable condition
activated_when (any of): The agreement has ended.

statement: Failing that, the tenant party shall pay in cash for the damage caused to the dwelling, the furniture or its services.
action: pay in cash for the damage to the dwelling, furniture or services
activated_when (any of): On termination, the dwelling, the furniture or its services show damage caused during the lease.

statement: The landlord is authorised, in the first place, to recover the damage from the deposit lodged.
action: recover the damage from the deposit
activated_when (any of): On termination, the dwelling, the furniture or its services show damage caused during the lease.

statement: The tenant party shall pay the landlord 950 euros, equivalent to one month's rent, to constitute the compulsory deposit established by law.
action: pay the deposit of one month's rent
activated_when (any of): The agreement is signed.

statement: The deposit shall be returned on termination of the agreement once the tenant party has fulfilled, to the landlord's satisfaction, the stipulations arising from it.
action: return the deposit
activated_when (any of): The agreement has ended.

statement: In no case may the amount of the deposit substitute for the monthly rent.
action: substitute the deposit for the monthly rent
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: Any delay in paying the rent shall be considered a breach and grounds for eviction.
activated_when (any of): The first six days of the month have passed without the tenant paying the rent.

statement: The tenant party is responsible not only for its own acts but also for those committed by the occupants of the dwelling.
activated_when (any of): An occupant of the dwelling (not the tenant) has caused damage to the landlord.

statement: The tenant party is responsible for any compensation for damages caused by its own acts and by those of the occupants of the dwelling.
action: compensate the damage caused by the occupants of the dwelling
activated_when (any of): The tenant answers for damage caused by an occupant (clause 11). | The tenant has caused damage to the landlord.

statement: The tenant party undertakes to report immediately and reliably to the landlord any incident affecting the property.
action: report immediately and reliably any incident affecting the property
activated_when (any of): An incident affecting the property occurs.

statement: Breach of the agreement by the tenant party shall oblige it to pay all court costs, lawyer's and court agent's fees, the tax assessment of the agreement and any other costs the landlord may incur to enforce it or to evict.
action: pay the court costs, lawyer's and court agent's fees, tax assessment and other costs
activated_when (any of): The tenant has breached the agreement. | The tenant is in breach because of a delay in paying the rent (clause 10).

statement: The tenant party undertakes to pay for the utilities, as well as the refuse collection charge, electricity, gas and internet.
action: pay the utilities, refuse charge, electricity, gas and internet
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The homeowners' association fees (which include water) are borne by the landlord.
action: pay the homeowners' association fees (water included)
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The parties submit, as required by law, to the jurisdiction of the courts of the place where the dwelling is located, waiving the tenant party's own forum.
activated_when (any of): (unconditional)

statement: The agreement has ended: the continuing obligations cease and the winding-up obligations arise (handing over the keys and the dwelling, returning the deposit).
activated_when (any of): The agreement has ended.
